description: Flood Fatalities database in western Algeria and Calabria (south Italy) is a hazard data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by 4TU.ResearchData. Flood mortality is still a serious concern in both developed and developing countries, requiring a deeper understanding to identify hazardous factors and mitigate the life losses. Coverage: Algeria. The portal files it under the publisher 4TU.ResearchData. Its tags are Physical Geography and Environmental Geoscience, FOS: Earth and related environmental sciences, Earth Sciences, Flood, Flood fatalities. The repository dates the deposit 2023; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Zero v1.0 Universal. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
